description: Synthetic contract fixtures for G3's builder half. Hand-written to exercise the parts of buildTripFromWishlist the golden 500 never reach — multi-day assignment, ordering, trimming, bases, airports, opening windows, live transit evidence and user overrides. Coordinates, addresses and stay durations are invented for determinism and do not measure real-world places; the TypeScript engine, not this file, is the oracle.
